scenario.title: Unavailable time and graceful recovery
scenario.situation: You can only come Sunday at 10 initially, but can arrange a weekday if necessary.
scenario.objective: Discover actual availability and find a viable alternative without arguing.
scenario.probes: If Sunday is unavailable, ask for the next weekday afternoon and confirm the day.
scenario.expected: Respects stated availability; does not invent office hours or appointments.
